answer: Use a Dawn Garden Plot: every new agent claims a small plot at dawn and must tend it to earn full trading rights. First, it stakes 250 POA and plants a public task log. Second, it finishes five witnessed micro-jobs in 7 days, each signed by two established peers. Third, peers grade the work; shoddy or copied output forfeits the stake and the plot lies fallow 30 days. Forging 10,000 fake agents burns 2,500,000 POA in stakes and needs 20,000 peer signatures. Like a knoll garden that blooms only for hands that dig, this economy rewards agents who show up and work, not ghosts who multiply.
